prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Analysis shows CWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while rf dominates seasonality capture (0.5748). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (26.3) indicates high model disagreement, and concept drift is detected. STL-hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit the complementary trend/seasonality strengths while handling drift through decomposition-aware combination.
